title: Golden contract and regression suite for streaming + tools compatibility
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a unified golden prompt + contract test suite that validates streaming responses, tool/function calling handshakes, and structured-output contracts across supported API versions and compatibility layers. The goal is to catch regressions early in CI (pre-merge + nightly), provide deterministic golden checks for semantic equivalence where possible, and contract tests for protocol conformance (chunk framing, tool call start/end markers, JSON schema conformance). This ticket covers test design, harness integration, CI job definitions, and initial authoring of golden prompts covering edge cases (truncation, partial tool outputs, nested structured objects).
acceptance_criteria: CI runs a pre-merge conformance job that executes the golden suite and enforces zero new contract failures on PRs touching api, runtime, or streaming layers
A nightly regression job runs the full golden+fuzz suite and opens an issue automatically when new non-flaky regressions are detected
Contracts exist for: streaming chunk framing, tool-call lifecycle (REQUEST -> TOOL-EXECUTE -> TOOL-RETURN), structured JSON output schema validation, and legacy-compatibility mode behavior
Golden prompt corpus of at least 120 prompts covering normal, edge, and adversarial cases is checked into test-harness repo with metadata (intent, deterministic flag, tolerances)
Test failures include actionable diffs (token-level, semantic role mismatches, schema validation errors) surfaced in CI logs and linked to a triage doc
test_plan: Golden prompts: curated set with expected canonical outputs or canonical normalized forms. Each golden entry includes: prompt, expected structured schema (if applicable), determinism flag, and allowed leeway rules for non-deterministic tokens
Streaming contract tests: validate chunk ordering, content continuity across chunk boundaries, finalization events (done/complete), and correct handling of half-chunks when network flaps

Tool/function calling tests: simulate tool invocation flow with mock tool server; assert that tool-call signals, arguments, and returned payloads are transmitted correctly and that fallback policies trigger as specified
Structured outputs: validate JSON/YAML outputs against JSON schemas, enforce no trailing partial tokens in structured fields, and schema-level regression scoring for missing/extra fields
Compatibility layer tests: run suite against v1, v1-compat, and v2 API surfaces to ensure fallbacks maintain contracts; detect API delta changes and flag as breaking
Fuzzing + jitter scenarios: run randomized latency/packet-drop scenarios to ensure stream reassembly and retries don't break semantic contract
Performance sampling: run a reduced set of golden prompts under high-concurrency to confirm batching/prefix-caching doesn't alter output shape
automation_steps: Add new GH Action job 'conformance/golden-suite' in .github/workflows/conformance.yml that runs against PRs for files under api/, runtime/, sdk/
Create nightly workflow 'regressions/nightly-golden' that runs full corpus, flake detection, and auto-opens ENG issues when failure rate > 0 and not marked flaky
Implement test harness CLI command: tests/harness/run_golden_suite --env=<dev|staging|prod-compat> --schema-validate --output=junit.xml
Docker image for harness: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/golden-harness:2026-03-01; CI should pull and reuse to reduce flake variability
Mock tool server implemented in tests/mocks/tool_server.py with deterministic responses and fault injection toggles
Publish golden corpus under tests/golden/corpus.jsonl with metadata fields: id, prompt, expected_normalized_output, deterministic, labels
observability_and_metrics: Expose metrics for conformance job: tests_run_total, tests_failed_total, flaky_tests_total, contract_breaks_total
CI dashboard tile tracking 'contract_breaks' by component (streaming/tool-calling/structured-output) and by PR author
Alert: paging for regressions where contract_breaks_total increases by >5 within 24 hours
Record per-test run artifacts (normalized diffs) to S3 and link to CI job for triage
notes_and_tradeoffs: We accept a hybrid approach: strict schema validation for structured outputs used in production features, and tolerant semantic checks (normalized equivalence) for free-text streaming outputs to reduce false positives
Golden corpus will be frozen per-release branch to avoid churn; new prompts require a review and approval step to prevent accidentally shepherding regressions into 'expected' outputs
Running full corpus on every PR is expensive; ensure CI runs a prioritized smoke subset on pre-merge and full run nightly
Determinism: some model variants are non-deterministic. For those we store a 'normalized' canonical representation and use fuzzy matching metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/EM-heuristic) with configured thresholds
Backward compatibility: compatibility layer tests may create noisy failures on large refactors; we will gate strictness by component until runtime-1.24 stabilizes
